description: Test suite for UnauthorizedFloodGuard class and isUnauthorizedRoleError function, verifying behavior of unauthorized response suppression and error detection.

classes.name: UnauthorizedFloodGuard
classes.description: Class that manages suppression of repeated unauthorized responses and controls connection closure behavior.

methods.name: registerUnauthorized
methods.description: Method that updates internal counters upon an unauthorized response and determines if the connection should be closed, logged, or if responses are being suppressed.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Method that resets the internal counters of the UnauthorizedFloodGuard.

methods.name: isUnauthorizedRoleError
methods.description: Function that checks if an error shape indicates an unauthorized role error.

ctags.name: guard
ctags.pattern: /^    const guard = new UnauthorizedFloodGuard({ closeAfter: 10, logEvery: 50 });$/

ctags.name: guard
ctags.pattern: /^    const guard = new UnauthorizedFloodGuard({ closeAfter: 2, logEvery: 3 });$/
